argitect

A pure-R command-line argument parser that reimplements the functionality of the Perl module Getopt::Long without any external dependency, and additionally supports positional arguments. It also provides rich, customizable help messages. This package is a replacement of the GetoptLong package.

argitect is a phonetic approximation of “arkitect”.

Install 

install.packages("argitect")

Usage 

library(argitect)

cutoff = 0.05
argitect(
    "number=i", "Number of items.",
    "cutoff=f", "Cutoff for filtering results.",
    "verbose!", "Print message.",
    "input=s#", "Input file (positional)."
)

Run from the command line:

Rscript foo.R --number 4 --cutoff 0.01 --verbose data.txt
Rscript foo.R --n4 -c=0.01 -v data.txt

Parsed values are exported as R variables in the calling environment.

Specification language

Each argument is name[|alias...]=spec. The value part spec is an optional mode and an optional type, optionally followed by a bracketed range or sub-argument list.

  • modes: i integer, f numeric, s character, l logical
  • types: $ scalar, # positional, @ vector, % hash (list)
Spec Meaning
number=i single integer scalar
name=s single character scalar
length|size=i integer scalar with two names
tag=i@ integer vector
tag=i@{2,4} integer vector with 2–4 elements
param=s% name=value pairs with character values
input=s# one positional argument
files=s#{} one or more positional arguments
arg=i%{foo, bar=f} hash with typed sub-arguments
verbose! logical, negatable with --no-verbose

Sub commands 

sub_commands(
    "cmd1.R", "First command.",
    "cmd2.R", "Second command."
)

Run from the command line:

Rscript main.R cmd1 ...
